author: FlammableSoloCups
body:
I've been mage classline for 4 years and im still having a blast with heretic. It kind of is an endless game of kill things and get better stuff, tier up and do it again. At T10 you spend your hard earned materials, orns, and gold for incecremntal increases to your stats. You keep the skills of classes that you buy, so reclassing isnt really necessary just short of buying the class for the skills. 

It's encouraged to try out all the classlines and run with the one you enjoy the most. A lot of players use different classes for different things (personally I do everything with heretic and its celestial variants).

author: capfedhill
body:
Join the Orna and Orna Legends discord and continuously read through some of the channels, such as the "questions' channel and "general" channel and the channel related to your class build.

The game gets much harder. The game is very nuanced and complicated, and a lot of it isnt explained very well. You will learn random facts from the discord that you wouldn't know elsewhere.

author: petr1petr
body:
join active kingdom. Try to find one in your are/timezone. Kingdoms are great for sharing information.

you can also check some youtube guides - Shabbash made great guides - some are a little outdated, but most of the info is still valid.

author: BearTheFerret
body: Orna is a journey, not a race. I don't think you'll find satisfaction in the game if your goal is to know everything super fast. If you can train your brain to enjoy the parts as they come along, you'll love it. I've played for about a year and still learn stuff everyday. As others have said, joining a good active kingdom really really helps.
